main.description: One drink, drunk once, by the author. Contains objective CATA detection and gLMS subjective valuation. The rating belongs to the drinker and describes the drink; `credits` attributes the people involved but carries no score.

venue.description: Absent for a pour at home.

menu.description: The menu sighting this was ordered from, if any.

perceivedIntensities.description: 0-100 gLMS scales for discrete structural/tactile vectors.

deviations.description: Patron feedback on drink balance (e.g. too-sweet, not-sweet-enough, too-sour).

cata.description: Check-All-That-Apply array for unbiased retronasal VOC categorization.

context.description: Transitory physiological and circadian state data for SSS and prandial normalization.

rating.description: Hedonic liking score anchored to standard psychophysical instruments.

hedonic.description: 1: dislike extremely, 5: neutral, 9: like extremely (standard 9-point hedonic).

glmsValence.description: Continuous bipolar gLMS liking score (-100 to +100).

wouldOrderAgain.description: Adoption rather than approval. Used to gauge recipe reception without personal scoring.

perceivedIntensities.description: 0-100 gLMS scales mapping discrete structural/tactile vectors.

context.description: Temporal and physiological state data for SSS and diurnal normalization.

volumeConsumedMl.description: Estimated volume consumed in milliliters (for sensory-specific satiety decay).

fastingDurationHours.description: Hours since last substantial meal (for ghrelin / postprandial sweet reward weighting).
